items.title: Show HN: Recallie AI – Duolingo for learning anything
items.raw_excerpt: I built an app with a Duolingo-style structured learning system where users can generate full courses from photos, documents, or typed input. Each course includes quizzes, flashcards, and notes, and users can also turn their notes into an AI-generated podcast for audio learning. It’s designed to help students and anyone who wants to learn a topic study smarter and retain more through interactive lessons, quizzes, and podcasts tailored to their learning style. Built with React Native Expo. https://youtu.be/jsRk1vN1xNA?si=iMGZFhj_N2iwBp5n

items.title: Large enterprise AI adoption declined 13% since July 2025 peak (US Census data)
items.raw_excerpt: U.S. Census Bureau data shows AI adoption among large firms has continued to decline after peaking in July 2025, while smallest firms keep growing

title_i18n.en: Large enterprise AI adoption declined 13% since July 2025 peak (US Census data)
title_i18n.zh: 自2025年7月峰值以来，大型企业人工智能采用率下降了13%（美国人口普查数据）。
title_i18n.es: La adopción de inteligencia artificial en grandes empresas disminuyó un 13 % desde el máximo de julio de 2025 (datos del censo de EE. UU.).

excerpt_i18n.en: U.S. Census Bureau data shows AI adoption among large firms has continued to decline after peaking in July 2025, while smallest firms keep growing
excerpt_i18n.zh: 美国人口普查局数据显示，大型企业的人工智能应用率自2025年7月达到峰值后持续下降，而最小型企业则保持增长态势。
excerpt_i18n.es: Los datos de la Oficina del Censo de EE. UU. muestran que la adopción de la inteligencia artificial en las grandes empresas ha seguido disminuyendo tras alcanzar su punto máximo en julio de 2025, mientras que las empresas más pequeñas mantienen un crecimiento continuo.

items.title: Most people rarely use AI, and dark personality traits predict who uses it more
items.raw_excerpt: Artificial intelligence dominates headlines, but new evidence shows most people barely use it in daily life. Researchers examined real-world web behavior and found low rates of AI use, often linked to traits like narcissism and Machiavellianism.

title_i18n.en: Most people rarely use AI, and dark personality traits predict who uses it more
title_i18n.zh: 大多数人很少使用人工智能，而性格阴暗特质可预测其使用频率更高。
title_i18n.es: La mayoría de las personas rara vez utiliza la inteligencia artificial, y los rasgos oscuros de personalidad predicen quién la usa más.

excerpt_i18n.en: Artificial intelligence dominates headlines, but new evidence shows most people barely use it in daily life. Researchers examined real-world web behavior and found low rates of AI use, often linked to traits like narcissism and Machiavellianism.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 人工智能占据头条，但新证据显示多数人在日常生活中几乎不用它。研究人员考察了真实网络行为，发现人工智能使用率低，常与自恋等特质相关。
excerpt_i18n.es: La inteligencia artificial domina los titulares, pero nuevas evidencias muestran que la mayoría de la gente apenas la usa en la vida diaria. Los investigadores examinaron el comportamiento web en el mundo real y encontraron bajas tasas de uso de la IA, a menudo vinculadas a rasgos como el narcisismo.
